title: Chapter 275 Rare Weapons
content:
Chapter 275 Rare Weapons

"Everyone, I don't need to say much about the preciousness of rare weapons. Lords who want to become the God of War should not miss it."

"There is no reserve price for this weapon. The auction will start now."

As soon as the voice fell, there was a commotion below.

"Fifty thousand."

"Hmph, a mere fifty thousand, you want to buy rare equipment, one hundred thousand."

The price was directly doubled.

Wang Shuo was about to bid, and Ye Tianba immediately said: "Two hundred thousand."

Wang Shuo looked back and felt a little embarrassed for a while.

Immediately someone surpassed his price.

"Five hundred thousand."

Crazy.

Few and fewer people followed the bidding.

To be honest, the price of five hundred thousand is a bit high.

But the goods are sold to the right people, and there will always be someone willing to be the sucker.

"Five hundred and fifty thousand."

Ye Tianba took a look at the price and sighed. He just sold a town heart and got four hundred thousand energy crystals, but the consumption of his territory was very huge, and he didn't dare to squander it all.

He wanted to ask Wang Shuo and others to borrow money, but it seemed that their relationship was not good enough.

Wang Shuo saw that Ye Tianba was no longer following up, so he slowly raised his hand: "Six hundred thousand."

Everyone turned their heads and saw that many lords recognized Wang Shuo immediately.

"It turned out to be Lord Wang. I am Turman, Lord of Dada Town. I hope you will give me a favor. I want this gun."

I have never heard of Dada Town.

I give you a favor? I don't want such a good thing? Don't I want face!

"I'm sorry, I also like this gun very much. I hope Mayor Turman will give it up."

"Humph, you are shameless, seven hundred thousand."

Wang Shuo's heart sank. What he feared most was this kind of dispute of will.

Raising the price for no reason.

But at this time, he was also a little bit in a dilemma and had to follow up.

"Seven hundred and fifty thousand."

"Eight hundred thousand."

The two confronted each other, and the other lords had already retreated.

To be honest, it is not worthwhile to buy a gun for 800,000 yuan.

Wouldn't it be nice to use these energy crystals to build an army?

Wang Shuo hesitated and paused for a while.

The host said slowly: "800,000 yuan once,..."

Wang Shuo finally decided to add one more time. If the other party followed up, he would give up.

"One million."

Wang Shuo said with a firm face, as if he had a momentum of not giving up until he achieved his goal.

Turman also struggled, and finally he twitched his mouth and said unwillingly: "You are so cruel, I will let you be the sucker."

Many lords present wanted to say that if I had the strength, I would also like to be the sucker, but unfortunately I have no choice.

Their entire territory could not get 1 million energy crystals.

After Wang Shuo traded for the Blood-Crying Gun, Ye Tianba's eyes also glowed with gold.

"Lord Wang, can you let me take a look at this gun?"

Ye Tianba said a little embarrassedly.

Wang Shuo checked the properties of the Blood-Crying Gun.

[Blood-sucking Spear: Rare quality, Strength +100, Attack +200, with blood-sucking effect, 3% of the damage caused by using the Blood-sucking Spear will be converted into the user's health. ]

Just one blood-sucking made Wang Shuo satisfied, which was the key to a protracted war.

Wang Shuo saw Ye Tianba's eager eyes and handed him the Blood-sucking Spear.

After taking the Blood-sucking Spear, he waved it a few times, looking quite capable.

It can be seen that he and Wang Shuo both used long spears.

Then, he returned the Blood-sucking Spear to Wang Shuo, and the few of them parted ways.

After returning to the territory, Wang Shuo calculated the time and found that the undead would be revived in a few days.

He was a little worried about how to use the Heart of the Town in his hand.
